zh-CN: 未压缩目录统一使用“校对更新”，详情操作移到项目名后，并精简时间与确认文案。
仓库工具可隐藏“未压缩”标签，批量撤回期间显示独立等待图标。
删除后撤回会恢复双向相似关系。
清除疑似重复项不再清除完全重复任务。
仓库格式和用户资料位置保持兼容，无需迁移。
en-US: Uncompressed folders consistently use Review Updates, with compact detail actions and simplified timestamps and confirmations.
Warehouse Tools can hide the Uncompressed tag, and bulk undo now shows a dedicated busy indicator.
Undoing deletion restores reciprocal similarity relationships.
Removing suspected duplicates no longer removes exact duplicates.
Warehouse formats and user-data locations remain compatible; no migration is needed.
